title: 对谈夏正：9个问题深度拷问中国茶市场
title_en: In Conversation with Xia Zheng: Nine Questions That Grill China's Tea Market
summary_cn: 一念草木中创始人夏正（前阿芙精油 VP）与主持人 CK、Iris 用 9 个问题拆解中国茶：万亿体量却极度散碎、立顿为何败走中国、无糖茶与现制茶饮的真实关系、普洱金融化骗局，以及一个原叶茶品牌如何在劣币驱逐良币的抖音环境里用「风味命名+高介入度」走出自己的路
summary_en: Xia Zheng, founder of Yinian Caomu and a former VP at Affu essential oils, sits down with hosts CK and Iris to take apart China's tea market through nine questions: a trillion-yuan scale that stays extremely fragmented, why Lipton lost China, the real relationship between unsweetened tea and freshly made tea drinks, the Pu'er financialization scam, and how a loose-leaf tea brand carves its own path in the bad-money-drives-out-good environment of Douyin — through flavor naming and high consumer involvement.

scenes.title_cn: 一、行业基本面：大而不强
scenes.title_en: Industry Basics: Big But Not Strong
scenes.context: 原叶茶 3500 亿市场却几乎没有存在感，品牌集中度极低。语域：casual 对谈 + 行业分析。
scenes.speak: Let's start with the industry basics. The loose-leaf tea market was about 350 billion yuan in 2024, yet it barely appears in brokerage reports — only a handful of public companies like Lancang Ancient Tea and Bama, and Chali is still on the edge of delisting. The key insight: the claim that 70,000 tea companies can't match Lipton dates to 2001, when China's tea output was over 30 billion yuan versus Lipton's global 30-plus billion. Even today, China's top ten loose-leaf brands still trail Lipton globally — but mainly because Chinese brands only play domestically while Lipton plays worldwide, much like Chinese box office versus Hollywood's global box office. A typical scene: when evaluating tea investments, don't just look at GMV — look at brand concentration, supply-chain integration, and consumer trust cost. As the guests say, this industry has no small size — it's actually huge — but it has almost no presence. Compared with coffee, the pattern is coffee at home equals tea abroad; China's bigger opportunity for tea may lie overseas, where it once made up a third of export trade. The cause is structural: around 10 million tea farmers plus a million tea enterprises means an extremely low entry barrier. The household responsibility system left production expansion uncontrolled — blueberries and Shine Muscat grapes are the cautionary tales. Division of labor is weak; a farmer who grows, processes, and sells it all himself is still trusted.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：2024 年原叶茶市场规模约 3500 亿，但几乎不出现在券商报告里——上市公司仅澜沧古茶、八马等少数，茶里还在退市边缘
sentences.en: The core mechanism: the loose-leaf tea market was about 350 billion yuan in 2024, yet it barely appears in brokerage reports — only a handful of public companies like Lancang Ancient Tea and Bama, and Chali is still on the edge of delisting.
sentences.note: 表达提示loose-leaf tea → 原叶茶；brokerage report → 券商报告；public company → 上市公司；delisting → 退市

sentences.cn: 关键理解：「7 万茶企不如立顿」源于 2001 年，当时中国茶产值 300 多亿 vs 立顿全球 300 多亿。至今前十原叶茶品牌仍不如立顿全球，但主因是中国品牌只做本土、立顿做全球，类似中国电影票房 vs 好莱坞全球票房
sentences.en: The key insight: the claim that 70,000 tea companies can't match Lipton dates to 2001, when China's tea output was over 30 billion yuan versus Lipton's global 30-plus billion. Even today, China's top ten loose-leaf brands still trail Lipton globally — but mainly because Chinese brands only play domestically while Lipton plays worldwide, much like Chinese box office versus Hollywood's global box office.
sentences.note: 表达提示box office → 票房；trail → 落后于；globally → 全球范围

sentences.cn: 典型场景：评估茶赛道投资时，不能只看 GMV，要看品牌集中度、供应链整合度、消费者信任成本

sentences.en: The cause: around 10 million tea farmers plus a million tea enterprises means an extremely low entry barrier. The household responsibility system left production expansion uncontrolled — blueberries and Shine Muscat grapes are the cautionary tales. Division of labor is weak; a farmer who grows, processes, and sells it all himself is still trusted.
sentences.note: 表达提示entry barrier → 准入门槛；cautionary tale → 前车之鉴；division of labor → 分工；self-sell → 自销

scenes.title_cn: 二、茶的四层结构与品牌机会
scenes.title_en: Tea's Four-Layer Structure and the Brand Opportunity
scenes.context: 功能/风味/文化/精神四层结构与销区品牌理论。语域：casual 对谈 + 商业模式分析。
scenes.speak: Next, the four-layer structure of tea. At the bottom is the functional drink — Lipton actually has higher polyphenol content because it uses old autumn leaves. In the middle is the flavor drink, pure experience with nothing to rationalize. At the top are culture, social ritual, and spiritual enjoyment. China's brand opportunity sits in the flavor and culture layers, not the functional one. As Xia Zheng says, let's put the food-value attribute aside — flavor has nothing to rationalize; it is experience, pure experience. The core mechanism: the closer a lightly processed agricultural product is to its origin, the harder it is to brand — think German home-brewed beer or coffee beans from a Brazilian friend. Europe grows no tea, which is why Lipton could become a global brand. With over a million tea enterprises in China, buying channels are so numerous they smother brands. The key insight, echoing Geographer Little Black: coffee brands are born in consumption regions. Beijing's Zhang Yiyuan and Wu Yutai are Anhui tea merchants, but their consumption base is Beijing. Yinian is a consumption-region brand — it sits firmly on the demand side. So the takeaway: when building a tea brand, don't just make a mountain-origin brand — build a consumption-region brand in a big enough market, or aim overseas.

sentences.cn: 底层功能性饮品（立顿茶多酚含量反而更高，因为用下秋老叶）；中间层风味饮品（纯体验，无道理可讲）；顶层文化社交与精神享受。中国品牌机会在风味与文化层，而非功能层
sentences.en: At the bottom is the functional drink — Lipton actually has higher polyphenol content because it uses old autumn leaves. In the middle is the flavor drink, pure experience with nothing to rationalize. At the top are culture, social ritual, and spiritual enjoyment. China's brand opportunity sits in the flavor and culture layers, not the functional one.
sentences.note: 表达提示polyphenol → 茶多酚；functional drink → 功能性饮品；flavor layer → 风味层；spiritual enjoyment → 精神享受

sentences.cn: （引用）「我们把食用属性先放到一边……风味这个东西没有什么道理可讲，它就是体验，就是纯体验。」
sentences.en: Direct quote: 'Let's put the food-value attribute aside... flavor has nothing to rationalize — it is experience, pure experience.'
sentences.note: 表达提示food-value attribute → 食用属性；pure experience → 纯体验

sentences.cn: 核心机制：粗加工农产品越靠近原产地越难品牌化（德国自酿啤酒、巴西朋友家咖啡豆）；欧洲不产茶所以立顿能做全球品牌。中国 100 万+ 茶企让购买渠道太多，压制了品牌
sentences.en: The core mechanism: the closer a lightly processed agricultural product is to its origin, the harder it is to brand — think German home-brewed beer or coffee beans from a Brazilian friend. Europe grows no tea, which is why Lipton could become a global brand. With over a million tea enterprises in China, buying channels are so numerous they smother brands.
sentences.note: 表达提示lightly processed → 粗加工；agricultural product → 农产品；smother → 压制

sentences.cn: 关键理解：吉普奥小黑观点——咖啡品牌诞生于销区（北京张一元、吴裕泰是安徽茶商但销区在北京）；一念是销区品牌，屁股站在需求端
sentences.en: The key insight, echoing Geographer Little Black: coffee brands are born in consumption regions. Beijing's Zhang Yiyuan and Wu Yutai are Anhui tea merchants, but their consumption base is Beijing. Yinian is a consumption-region brand — it sits firmly on the demand side.
sentences.note: 表达提示consumption region → 销区；demand side → 需求端；sit on → 站在…一边

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：做茶品牌不要只做茶山品牌，要在足够大的消费市场建立销区品牌，或瞄准海外
sentences.en: How to make it real: when building a tea brand, don't just make a mountain-origin brand — build a consumption-region brand in a big enough market, or aim overseas.
sentences.note: 表达提示mountain-origin brand → 茶山品牌；consumption-region brand → 销区品牌；aim overseas → 瞄准海外

paraphrase.chunks: closer to origin · origin goods resist branding

scenes.title_cn: 三、袋泡茶、无糖茶与现制茶饮
scenes.title_en: Teabags, Unsweetened Tea, and Freshly Made Tea Drinks
scenes.context: 袋泡茶为何在中国火不了、无糖茶与现制茶饮的原叶茶含量。语域：casual 对谈 + 品类辨析。
scenes.speak: Now teabags, unsweetened tea, and freshly made tea drinks. The cause: Chinese food aesthetics want the whole thing — a whole chicken in one hand, a whole duck in the other. Steak must be a clean cut; a beef patty is fast food. Teabags are like beef scraps: you only drink them when convenience outweighs quality, at the office, on business trips, outdoors. The fix: Yinian's teabag line has matching loose-leaf products, so consumers don't doubt the quality — but teabags still make up under 20 percent of shipments. Watch out — it's not that the category is weak; it's a mismatch between the form and cultural aesthetics. As the guest jokes, serve a guest a teabag and they'll be gone in five minutes — are you really welcoming me? And do unsweetened teas and freshly made drinks count as tea consumption? The guest says no, not really: Oriental Leaf counts, but freshly made tea drinks haven't produced a brand comparable to specialty pour-over or black coffee, and pure tea makes up too small a share. The first wave of users came from Starbucks, Luckin, and Heytea mini-programs, and ages 28 to 35 is the peak window for exploring loose-leaf tea. One useful framing: loose-leaf tea should be compared to instant coffee powder, just add hot water, not coffee beans — the barrier is far lower than pour-over, and even aged white tea works fine brewed in a thermos.

sentences.cn: 原因：中国饮食审美是「左手一只鸡右手一只鸭」——整鸡整鸭整鱼，牛排要圆切，牛肉饼=快餐。袋泡茶像「牛肉碎」，只有便携性压过品质需求时才喝（办公室/出差/户外）
sentences.en: The cause: Chinese food aesthetics want the whole thing — a whole chicken in one hand, a whole duck in the other. Steak must be a clean cut; a beef patty is fast food. Teabags are like beef scraps: you only drink them when convenience outweighs quality, at the office, on business trips, outdoors.
sentences.note: 表达提示whole chicken/duck → 整鸡整鸭；beef patty → 牛肉饼；convenience outweighs quality → 便携压过品质

sentences.cn: 解法：一念袋泡线有对应原叶产品，消费者不怀疑品质；但出货占比不到 20%
sentences.en: The fix: Yinian's teabag line has matching loose-leaf products, so consumers don't doubt the quality — but teabags still make up under 20 percent of shipments.
sentences.note: 表达提示matching loose-leaf product → 对应的原叶产品；make up → 占比；shipment → 出货

sentences.cn: 严重程度：小心——不是品类不行，是形态与文化审美错位
sentences.en: How serious: watch out — it's not that the category is weak; it's a mismatch between the form and cultural aesthetics.
sentences.note: 表达提示mismatch → 错位；cultural aesthetics → 文化审美

sentences.cn: （引用）嘉宾说法：「家里来客人你上个袋泡茶，人家五分钟就要走人——你是欢迎我吗？」
sentences.en: Guest quote: 'You serve a guest a teabag and they'll be gone in five minutes — are you really welcoming me?'
sentences.note: 表达提示serve a guest → 招待客人；be gone in five minutes → 五分钟就要走

sentences.cn: 嘉宾回答：不算。东方树叶算茶消费；现制茶饮还没跑出对标精品手冲/黑咖的品牌，纯茶占比太低。第一波用户来自星巴克/瑞幸/喜茶小程序，28-35 岁是探索原叶茶的高峰期
sentences.en: The guest answers: no, not really. Oriental Leaf counts as tea consumption, but freshly made tea drinks haven't produced a brand comparable to specialty pour-over or black coffee, and pure tea makes up too small a share. The first wave of users came from Starbucks, Luckin, and Heytea mini-programs; ages 28 to 35 is the peak window for exploring loose-leaf tea.
sentences.note: 表达提示pour-over → 手冲；black coffee → 黑咖；pure tea → 纯茶；mini-program → 小程序

sentences.cn: （引用）相关概念：原叶茶应对标速溶咖啡粉（有水一冲就行），而非咖啡豆——门槛比手冲低得多，老白茶保温杯泡都没问题
sentences.en: Related concept: loose-leaf tea should be compared to instant coffee powder, just add hot water, not coffee beans — the barrier is far lower than pour-over, and even aged white tea works fine brewed in a thermos.
sentences.note: 表达提示instant coffee → 速溶咖啡；aged white tea → 老白茶；thermos → 保温杯

paraphrase.intent: 想说「袋泡茶像牛肉碎，上不了台面」
phrases: Teabags are the beef scraps of tea.
Serve a teabag and your guest is halfway out the door.
paraphrase.chunks: beef scraps of tea · halfway out the door
paraphrase.usage: 第二句呼应原引用，更有画面感

paraphrase.intent: 想说「原叶茶门槛没想象中高」

scenes.title_cn: 四、成瘾性、金融化与礼品化陷阱
scenes.title_en: Addiction, Financialization, and the Gift Trap
scenes.context: 茶的成瘾机制、普洱金融化骗局与「能喝的古董」叙事。语域：casual 对谈 + 避坑提醒。
scenes.speak: Then the traps. First, addiction: cigarettes, alcohol, and coffee hook you through withdrawal. Tea's pull is a composite feeling — flavor, body sensation, scene-triggered ritual, daily habit, and dopamine-driven collecting, like flipping through tea cards or hunting rare varietals. The key insight: once hooked, people make a dozen-plus orders a year; before that, they buy five or six boxes of teabags a year as a beverage. L-theanine calms the mood and lowers cortisol — positive pleasure, not withdrawal pain. As Xia Zheng says, tea's addictiveness points to a composite feeling, and tea is more like another version of Labubu. Then there's financialization. The drinkable-antique narrative and the cross-strait tea heritage rediscovery, like the touching revival story of the seven-cake stack, got exploited by financial players — promising 15 percent annual buyback. The cake is just a token, and you can't tell the million-yuan tea from the 10,000-yuan one. The fix: buy tea to drink, not to flip. Beware the buy-back-next-year-at-15-percent pitch. Raw, ripe, and aged Pu'er are completely different things — figure out the category first. And it's fatal: the collapse of the laodeng economy is directly tied to the Pu'er auction bubble.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：烟酒咖啡的成瘾来自戒断反应；茶的成瘾指向综合感受——风味+体感+场景触发+生活习惯+多巴胺驱动（翻牌子喝茶、收集小众茶）
sentences.en: The core mechanism: cigarettes, alcohol, and coffee hook you through withdrawal. Tea's pull is a composite feeling — flavor, body sensation, scene-triggered ritual, daily habit, and dopamine-driven collecting, like flipping through tea cards or hunting rare varietals.
sentences.note: 表达提示withdrawal → 戒断反应；composite feeling → 综合感受；body sensation → 体感；rare varietal → 小众茶

sentences.cn: 关键理解：入坑后年均十几单高频消费；未入坑者每年买五六盒袋泡茶当饮料。茶氨酸安抚情绪、降皮质醇，是正向愉悦而非戒断痛苦
sentences.en: The key insight: once hooked, people make a dozen-plus orders a year; before that, they buy five or six boxes of teabags a year as a beverage. L-theanine calms the mood and lowers cortisol — positive pleasure, not withdrawal pain.
sentences.note: 表达提示get hooked → 入坑；L-theanine → 茶氨酸；cortisol → 皮质醇；positive pleasure → 正向愉悦

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「茶的成瘾性，指向的是一种综合感受……而茶更像是另一个版本的 Labubu。」
sentences.en: Direct quote: 'Tea's addictiveness points to a composite feeling... and tea is more like another version of Labubu.'
sentences.note: 表达提示composite feeling → 综合感受；another version of → 另一个版本

sentences.cn: 原因：「能喝的古董」叙事+两岸茶文化寻根（七子饼复原故事很动人）被金融玩家利用——承诺 15% 年回购，茶饼只是标的物，100 万和 1 万的茶根本分不清
sentences.en: The cause: the 'drinkable antique' narrative and cross-strait tea heritage rediscovery, like the touching revival story of the seven-cake stack, got exploited by financial players — promising 15 percent annual buyback. The cake is just a token, and you can't tell the million-yuan tea from the 10,000-yuan one.
sentences.note: 表达提示drinkable antique → 能喝的古董；buyback → 回购；token → 标的物；seven-cake stack → 七子饼

sentences.cn: 解法：买茶为喝不为炒；警惕「明年回购+15%」话术；普洱生茶/熟茶/老茶是不同东西，先搞清品类
sentences.en: The fix: buy tea to drink, not to flip. Beware the 'buy back next year at 15 percent' pitch. Raw, ripe, and aged Pu'er are completely different things — figure out the category first.
sentences.note: 表达提示flip → 炒卖；pitch → 话术；raw/ripe/aged Pu'er → 生茶/熟茶/老茶

sentences.cn: 严重程度：致命——老登经济崩盘与普洱拍卖泡沫直接相关
sentences.en: How serious: fatal — the collapse of the laodeng economy is directly tied to the Pu'er auction bubble.
sentences.note: 表达提示collapse → 崩盘；auction bubble → 拍卖泡沫；directly tied to → 与…直接相关

paraphrase.intent: 想说「茶的成瘾是综合感受不是戒断」
phrases: Tea hooks you with experience, not withdrawal.
It's dopamine and ritual, not dependence.
paraphrase.chunks: experience not withdrawal · dopamine and ritual

phrases: Buy tea to drink, not to speculate.
If a cake promises buyback, it's a product, not a tea.
paraphrase.chunks: drink not speculate · buyback means product

scenes.title_cn: 五、一念草木中：反共识的品牌实践
scenes.title_en: Yinian Caomu: A Contrarian Brand in Practice
scenes.context: 一念草木中的高频复购、风味命名与抖音劣币驱逐良币的困境。语域：casual 对谈 + 品牌复盘。
scenes.speak: Finally, how Yinian Caomu puts this into practice. On WeChat Channels: over 20,000 buyers, more than 10,000 repurchasing, a 50 percent rate, 500,000 total orders, and 50 orders per person — moving faster than face cream. But breaking beyond the core is hard: peach oolong can go viral, while Longjing and Da Hong Pao sell forever without spreading. As Xia Zheng notes, over 10,000 people placed 500,000 orders, 50 per person — that's incredibly high frequency. The core mechanism: instead of 'West Lake Longjing pre-Qingming community cultivar,' they use names like Red Stove Sipping Snow and Evening Light Over the Hills. Flavor lands on a distinctive name, so consumers only need to remember the experience and the name. Category names also communicate poorly in a non-standard industry, since both the 9.9-yuan and the 10,000-yuan-per-jin tea get called Longjing. The key insight: the vision is to reshape the moment a Chinese person meets tea — understanding tea through flavor and cultural imagination, not starting from origin qualifiers. Each tea is an information package: 50 grams, brewed ten times, with a new discovery every time. To make it real: give products story-driven names with supporting content — images, stories, flavor notes — to raise consumer involvement, which works better than simply cutting prices. And the hardest part: on Douyin's rankings you get fake Laobanzhang at 300 yuan per jin and fake rock tea at 500, with actors dressed as farmers selling live. Real brands get called harvesting the leeks. Five years of trial-drink subsidies and cashback, over 10 million yuan, can't outweigh a few fake farmers putting on a show.

sentences.cn: 视频号 2 万+购买用户，1 万+复购（50%），累计 50 万单，人均 50 单——比面霜还快销。但破圈难：蜜桃乌龙能火，龙井大红袍能卖一辈子
sentences.en: On WeChat Channels: over 20,000 buyers, more than 10,000 repurchasing, a 50 percent rate, 500,000 total orders, and 50 orders per person — moving faster than face cream. But breaking beyond the core is hard: peach oolong can go viral, while Longjing and Da Hong Pao sell forever without spreading.
sentences.note: 表达提示repurchase rate → 复购率；break beyond the core → 破圈；go viral → 火起来

sentences.cn: （引用）「1 万多人买了 50 万单，人均 50 单……这可太高频了。」
sentences.en: Direct quote: 'Over 10,000 people placed 500,000 orders, 50 per person... that's incredibly high frequency.'
sentences.note: 表达提示high frequency → 高频；orders per person → 人均订单

sentences.cn: 核心机制：不用「西湖龙井明前群体种」而用「红炉饮雪」「晚照山光」——把风味落在独特名字上，消费者记住体验和名字即可。品类名在非标行业沟通效率也不高（9.9 元和 1 万一斤都叫龙井）
sentences.en: The core mechanism: instead of 'West Lake Longjing pre-Qingming community cultivar,' they use names like 'Red Stove Sipping Snow' and 'Evening Light Over the Hills.' Flavor lands on a distinctive name, so consumers only need to remember the experience and the name. Category names also communicate poorly in a non-standard industry, since both the 9.9-yuan and the 10,000-yuan-per-jin tea get called Longjing.
sentences.note: 表达提示non-standard industry → 非标行业；communicate poorly → 沟通效率低；per jin → 每斤

sentences.cn: 关键理解：愿景是「重塑中国人和茶相遇那一瞬间的体验」——从风味与文化想象理解茶，而非从产地限定词开始。每款茶是「信息包」，50 克喝 10 次每次有新发现
sentences.en: The key insight: the vision is to reshape the moment a Chinese person meets tea — understanding tea through flavor and cultural imagination, not starting from origin qualifiers. Each tea is an information package: 50 grams, brewed ten times, with a new discovery every time.
sentences.note: 表达提示origin qualifier → 产地限定词；information package → 信息包；brew → 冲泡

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：给产品起有故事感的名字+配套内容（图/故事/风味），提高用户介入度，比单纯降价更有效
sentences.en: How to make it real: give products story-driven names with supporting content — images, stories, flavor notes — to raise consumer involvement. That works better than simply cutting prices.
sentences.note: 表达提示story-driven name → 有故事感的名字；consumer involvement → 用户介入度；supporting content → 配套内容

sentences.cn: 原因：抖音排行 300 元/斤假老班章、500 元/斤假岩茶，演员扮茶农直播；真品牌被骂「割韭菜」。五年累计补贴试喝返现超 1000 万，抵不过几个假农民演一演
sentences.en: The cause: on Douyin's rankings you get fake Laobanzhang at 300 yuan per jin and fake rock tea at 500, with actors dressed as farmers selling live. Real brands get called 'harvesting the leeks.' Five years of trial-drink subsidies and cashback, over 10 million yuan, can't outweigh a few fake farmers putting on a show.
sentences.note: 表达提示fake → 假货；dressed as farmers → 扮茶农；harvesting the leeks → 割韭菜；cashback → 返现

paraphrase.intent: 想说「高频复购比爆款更重要」
phrases: Fifty orders per customer beats one viral hit.
Frequency is the moat in this category.
paraphrase.chunks: frequency is the moat · per customer

paraphrase.intent: 想说「把风味落在名字上」
phrases: Give the flavor a name people can remember.
A poetic name beats an origin label.
paraphrase.chunks: a name people can remember · poetic name beats origin
paraphrase.usage: 第二句直接点出反共识打法

practice.cn: 用「no presence」说：行业体量很大但几乎没有存在感。
practice.en: The industry is huge but has almost no presence.

practice.cn: 用「consumption-region brand」说：品牌应该站在需求端做销区品牌。
practice.en: Build a consumption-region brand that sits on the demand side.

practice.cn: 用「drinkable antique」说：「能喝的古董」叙事被金融玩家利用。
practice.en: The 'drinkable antique' narrative got exploited by financial players.

practice.cn: 用「harvesting the leeks」说：真品牌反而被骂割韭菜。
practice.en: Real brands get called out for harvesting the leeks.

pitfalls.wrong: The tea industry is big but has no feeling.
pitfalls.right: The tea industry is huge but has almost no presence.
pitfalls.why: 「存在感」不是 feeling；presence 才指市场可见度。

pitfalls.wrong: Lipton is more strong than Chinese tea brands.
pitfalls.right: Lipton's global reach outscales China's top ten combined.
pitfalls.why: more strong 语法错误；outscale / outweigh 才是比较的正确表达。

pitfalls.wrong: Teabag is like beef crumbs, not welcome for guests.
pitfalls.right: Teabags are like beef scraps — fine for convenience, never for guests.
pitfalls.why: 牛肉碎是 beef scraps 不是 crumbs；补上 convenience vs guests 的对比更完整。

pitfalls.wrong: Don't buy tea for selling, buy for drinking.
pitfalls.right: Buy tea to drink, not to flip.
pitfalls.why: buy for selling 是中式表达；flip / speculate 才是「炒」的地道说法。

shifts.before: 以为中国茶行业很大很成熟
shifts.after: 体量巨大但极度散碎：1000 万茶农+100 万茶企，几乎没品牌集中度
袋泡茶像「牛肉碎」——形态与文化审美错位，中国消费者要整鸡整鸭

shifts.before: 以为茶品牌要讲产地限定（西湖龙井明前）
shifts.after: 把风味落在独特名字上，用高介入度重建人和茶的相遇体验
